title: Rosedalean SMP season 2
description: Rosedalean SMP season 2 - Hop on and make some friends !
body:
Welcome to the Rosedalean SMP! We are currently in the preparation stage for season 2 which means a fresh start and a whole new chance for you to get involved!

We've specially curated a wide range of standout mods perfect for all types of players! Such as an array of furniture mods, the create mod + create addons, extra biomes with biomes o plenty, Voice chat mod, a fun and exciting world with tectonic, and so, so, so much more!

If lore is your style we also have a dedicated community to act and play with, whether you want to create your own character and role play with others or if you just simply want to settle down with a cool base whilst hanging out with friends, we could be for you! 

We strive to be a community based server and have big plans for guilds and community events to bring the people together, such as in game events, weekly discord game nights, and story building for those interested in lore! 

Although we are still in our preparation stage at the moment, things are looking positive and we strive to open our season 2 server in late June/early July! Join now and be one of the first to take part in the new server experience!

Join our discord to get approved and whitelisted : https://discord.gg/ue2AJBe2V5
